headline: Housing project at 1727 First Street presented by Salem Housing Authority with a developer partner.
summary: The Salem Housing Authority, a quasi-government agency separate from the city, manages 454 elderly and disabled units, 211 family units, and 1,346 federal vouchers. The site, off Highland Ave, is in early planning and could be ready in a few years, and the authority wants to add a daycare program there. Its nonprofit, Housing Opportunities of Salem Incorporated, owns 39 units and is seeking board members. Members also elected Thomas Pinier Shields as chair and Kate Jordan as vice chair.
decisions: Elected Thomas Pinier Shields as chair and Kate Jordan as vice chair, 5-0.
discussion: Housing Authority presentation: Members asked about the authority's nonprofit, tenant input, and data for research. The presenter said the nonprofit could apply for grants the authority cannot, and that the First Street project would share profits with a developer who would manage the property.

Business fundraising: Business people contacted for the idea showed little support for giving money to the city, and several said small businesses could not give ongoing gifts. A member offered to contact Essex County Community Foundation.

Efficiency housing rules: Efficiency housing, also called SROs, is now its own use in the framework. The city plans a committee of the whole meeting for council feedback in December or January, then a zoning amendment likely in the first couple months of the year.

Transfer fees: The mayor plans to discuss the framework with other communities through the Mass Municipal Association. A member said a transfer fee was stripped from a state bill, so a group effort across cities might work better than one city acting alone.

Tenant opportunity to purchase: A bill in conference committee could create a pilot program letting tenants buy a building when the landlord sells it. Members want research on how similar laws have worked before the legislative session ends in January.

decision_evidence.quote: So we have a motion to move for me to be chair for me to be chair and Kate to be vice chair. ... I think we have a motion passes.

decision_titles: Officer elections: chair and vice chair
